resource_code.description: Unique resource code matching Excel and folder name (e.g. MM-G12-BIO-L001).

entry_file.description: Relative entry HTML file path within the resource package.

version.description: Incremental version integer for package revisions.

offline_enabled.description: Whether package is approved for offline local caching.

required_files.description: List of explicit required relative file paths inside package.

content_sha256.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of package file tree.
